visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit modern office setting, a man in a grey suit and another in a blue shirt stand and talk animatedly to a seated man with blond-streaked hair. They point at documents on the desk and gesture with wide hand movements. The man in blue pats the seated man's shoulder before they both walk away. (2) The man with blond-streaked hair looks towards the camera with a neutral expression, then looks at another man sitting next to him in a grey jacket. A hand enters the frame and slams a piece of paper onto the desk, forcefully crumpling it into a ball. The man with streaks appears increasingly frustrated. (3) A close-up shot shows a hand passing a white envelope labeled with black characters across a desk surface. A man in a black button-up shirt (the boss) leans forward, talking intensely while using expressive hand gestures to emphasize his points. The man with streaks listens with a solemn, sad expression. (4) The man with streaks reaches out and gently strokes the boss's cheek. The boss's face shifts from a serious, focused expression to one of extreme shock and bewilderment, freezing in place as yellow variety-style text overlays appear on the screen.

Music remains upbeat but dips in volume to accommodate the vocals. The spectral brightness decreases as the track emphasizes emotional weight and narrative tension. (4) The sentimental music reaches a melodic peak. A soft, breathy male voice delivers a short line. narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Setup -> Workplace Success -> Internal Conflict -> Melodramatic Parody -> Humorous Subversion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This is a comedic sketch by the well-known Taiwanese group 'This Group of People' (TGOP). The video parodies common tropes from classic TV dramas, specifically 'The Fierce Wife', by transplanting over-the-top sentimental acting and dialogue into a mundane office environment. The primary intent is to entertain through the absurdity of workplace interactions being treated with cinematic melodrama.
